verdict.line: You lose this if you trade face-to-face into his Q-into-E combo; you win it by stacking Ionian Fervor and Conqueror, then chaining E's mark into Q resets to all-in on your terms.

brief.thesis: Every point of Ornn's threat is magic damage delivered through a slow-into-knockup chain — Q (Volcanic Rupture) drops a delayed pillar, and E (Searing Charge) knocks up if he collides with it or a wall — which Irelia's only defensive tool, W (Defiant Dance), cannot answer since it only reduces physical damage. That's why this sits at 47.4% over 919 games, below Irelia's 50.3% baseline: she has to win the matchup on cooldown tempo and resets, not by tanking his combo.

theirWindow.when: right after his Q pillar lands near you
theirWindow.what: He can follow immediately with E (Searing Charge) and knock you up if he collides with that pillar or nearby terrain. Step off the pillar's landing spot the instant you see it drop.

yourWindow.when: at 4 Ionian Fervor stacks with Conqueror live
yourWindow.what: Land E (Flawless Duet) to stun and Mark him, then Q (Bladesurge) in — the Mark refreshes Q's cooldown on hit, letting you chain in and out faster than he can reset his Q/E combo.

start.why: 88.4% pick rate at 48.1% WR over 964 games — the sustain and early trade damage let you poke his Q cooldown windows without a potion-starved lane.

boots.why: 52.2% pick, 49.1% WR over 525 games — his entire kit is magic damage, and the tenacity shortens the window his Searing Charge or R elemental knockup can chain a follow-up onto you.

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking Conqueror through extended trades is literally the engage condition OP.GG calls out for this matchup — you don't commit until stacks and Conqueror are both up, and the adaptive heal offsets his Q/E poke.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the highest-winrate pairing in this sample (50.5% over its share of 919 games) — Teleport lets you reset waves after he trades you down early and still scale into the stacks-plus-Conqueror all-in window. Flash+Ignite (76.1% pick) is the more common choice if you want kill pressure the moment he mistimes E into terrain.

playing.title: Respect the Q-into-E combo
playing.detail: Ornn's Q (Volcanic Rupture, 9-7s CD) slows and drops a delayed pillar; if he follows with E (Searing Charge, 14-12s CD) into that pillar or a wall, it knocks you up. Clear the pillar's spot the moment it lands.

playing.title: Don't lean on W defensively
playing.detail: W (Defiant Dance) only reduces physical damage while charging, and Ornn's entire kit is magic — treat it purely as your hardest-hitting poke tool, not a shield against his combo.

playing.title: Farm stacks with Q before committing
playing.detail: Use Q (Bladesurge) on casters and minions to build Ionian Fervor attack-speed stacks safely from range before you step into his Q/E threat radius.

playing.title: Chain E's mark into a Q reset
playing.detail: E (Flawless Duet) stuns and Marks anyone caught between the blades; landing it on Ornn lets your next Q refresh on hit, letting you dash in and out faster than his cooldowns reset.

playing.title: Back off the instant Brittle lands
playing.detail: His W (Bellows Breath) final flame and R elemental both apply Brittle, boosting his next hit on you — if it ticks onto your bar mid-trade, disengage instead of trading through it.

playing.title: Deny the wall collision
playing.detail: His E only knocks up off a terrain or pillar collision — fighting in open lane space instead of near the tri-bush wall removes that tool from the trade entirely.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical read on cooldown windows, the Brittle/knockup combo, and the stack-timing engage pattern is this brief's own analysis layered on top of the live ability text.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being hit with Ornn’s (Q)-(E) combo. Engage for a kill whenever Irelia has 4 stacks [P] and Conqueror stacks prepared, or to at least force a summoner spell.
